# 09 - Known Issues & Fragile Areas

Create `fragile.md`:
- Which parts of the codebase break when touched?
- Past regressions: what broke, why, and was it caught before release?
- Any module nobody wants to open?
- Known tech debt you have already decided to live with
- Things that look like bugs but are intentional

This directly becomes the QA regression gate. Be brutally honest here -
it is the highest-value file in the whole shoebox.
